About

I'm a multidisciplinary freelancer currently living in Antwerp, London, Sydney, Amsterdam,LondonBali, Hamburg. I'm specialised in design . concept . motion . direction. with a love for digital and innovative technologies. Crafter of interactive experiences, creating high quality work with the eye for detail, as well online as offline. I'm not afraid of a challenge, I like pushing boundaries and love working with talented people. I'm always looking for exciting projects.
